assertions.description: PublicKeyCredential.getClientCapabilities() exists — the feature-detection surface the spec extends with the conditionalPassiveGet capability.
getClientCapabilities() reports the ClientCapability "conditionalPassiveGet" as true: the client can do conditional mediation with uiMode "passive" for authentication ceremonies.
credentials.get() reads the uiMode member of CredentialRequestOptions (observed with a getter and an already-aborted signal, so no request or UI is started).
uiMode: "passive" combined with mediation: "conditional" is accepted by options conversion (an already-aborted signal rejects with AbortError, not TypeError).
A conditional + passive request does not resolve or reject on its own while no credential is selected: with no credentials for the origin there is no UI and the promise never settles.
assertions.test: Not run automatically: a live conditional request would collide with the demo pages' own pending request (one WebAuthn request per page). Verify with the passive-sign-in-prompt concept, which runs it live and shows the pending state until aborted.

assertions.description: With uiMode "passive" the user agent shows discoverable credentials immediately in a minimally disruptive, non-modal prompt, and shows nothing when no credentials exist.
assertions.test: Browser UI cannot be observed from page script; verify by hand with chrome://flags/#web-authentication-ambient-signin enabled, once with and once without a passkey for the origin (see the passive-sign-in-prompt concept).

assertions.description: A single conditional + passive request also surfaces in autofill on a webauthn-tagged input, and selecting a credential in either surface resolves the same promise.
assertions.test: Requires interacting with browser autofill and the passive prompt; verify by hand on the passive-plus-autofill concept.
